mapper.sql: d.DOCUMENT_ID, d.DOCUMENT_NO, d.SUPPLIER_ID, d.PAYABLE_AMOUNT, d.PAID_AMOUNT, d.REMAINING_AMOUNT, d.DOCUMENT_STATUS, d.DUE_DATE, d.CURRENCY, d.EXCHANGE_RATE, d.BUSINESS_TYPE, d.SUMMARY, d.REMARKS, d.AUDIT_USER, d.AUDIT_TIME, d.AUDIT_COMMENTS, d.CREATE_TIME, d.CREATE_BY, s.SUPPLIER_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_PAYABLE_DOCUMENT d LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON d.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE d.DOCUMENT_ID = #{documentId} AND d.IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(PAYABLE_AMOUNT), 0) as totalPayable, COALESCE(SUM(PAID_AMOUNT), 0) as totalPaid, COALESCE(SUM(REMAINING_AMOUNT), 0) as totalUnpaid FROM TBL_PAYABLE_DOCUMENT WHERE IS_DELETED = 0
AND SUPPLIER_ID = #{supplierId}
SELECT FROM TBL_PAYABLE_DOCUMENT d LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON d.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE d.IS_DELETED = 0 AND d.REMAINING_AMOUNT > 0 AND d.DUE_DATE < CURDATE() ORDER BY d.DUE_DATE ASC
SELECT FROM TBL_PAYABLE_DOCUMENT d LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON d.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE d.SUPPLIER_ID = #{supplierId} AND d.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY d.CREATE_TIME DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_PAYABLE_DOCUMENT SET PAID_AMOUNT = #{paidAmount}, REMAINING_AMOUNT = PAYABLE_AMOUNT - #{paidAmount}, UPDATE_TIME = NOW() WHERE DOCUMENT_ID = #{documentId}
